function.name: devnet_api_call
function.description:
Search Cisco DevNet developer documentation (rooted at https://developer.cisco.com). Public content, no credentials — do NOT use requests.

RETURN VALUE: a JSON string; json.loads it -> {"status_code", "data", "error", "blast_radius"}.

USAGE:
  GET /search/?q=<query>    Search DevNet content — API docs, code examples, learning labs. Returns matching pages/docs.

GOOD QUERIES: include the product + the operation, e.g. "meraki getNetworkClients", "catalyst center create site", "pyats parse show ip route". For Meraki/Catalyst Center, searching the operationId finds the exact API reference.

BLAST RADIUS: everything is low (read-only). Cite the doc links you surface.
